title: FocusFarm
summary: A student signature-work research project that generates and classifies synthetic time-series activity sequences, including a script that fits classification models on the generated data. Its synthesize.py module builds SDV metadata objects and runs SDV's PARSynthesizer to fit, save, load, and sample sequential synthetic data.
evidence: synthesize.py:203-219 constructs PARSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata/Metadata, then fits, saves, and loads it to sample synthetic sequences.
needs: Domain/industry of the underlying activity data (e.g., focus/behavior tracking) is not specified in the truncated README, so industry classification is uncertain.
